events.author: allwillretire
events.text:
Hey fam 👋 
I want to continue to address the unexpected bonding of $AWR a couple of days ago.
Many of you have taken large losses. I am sorry for that. My belief is that you took a position in $AWR as a result of momentum plays from us unexpectedly bonding. We got some attention from @MustStopMurad . Lots of those large losses came as a result from buying at a top.
I want to take a moment to acknowledge that I see you. I also want to acknowledge the losses you have taken on your position.
I also want to let you know that I am continuing to show up daily to develop our community and deliver on our vision and help the growth of AWR. I hope that I can build up trust and a relationship with you such that you will stick around with us and consider yourself an AWR believer.
I have been trying to track down owners of wallet addresses on X and personally reach out to you.
Many wallets I have been unsuccessful at identifying whom I can speak to directly. If I haven't reached out to you because I can't identify you it doesn't signify that you aren't important to me or the community. It shouldn't marginalize you or your losses at all.
Anyways I wanted to let you know that I care about you and want you to feel seen.
I hope you will join us and look at this as finding an unexpected gem.
Thank you fam ♥️ 🙏 
Diamond hands wanted 💎 🤲 See you at retirement
